title: First-run Launchpad mosaic + responsive step frames for Quickstart landing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Refresh the Quickstart landing hero and the first-run step mosaic to improve clarity for new developers, reduce cognitive load, and provide accurate product screenshots for the 2026.03 release. Deliver static hero art, Lottie/animated hero variant, three responsive step frames (desktop/tablet/mobile), and a screenshot export pipeline that masks customer data and supports translations.
acceptance_criteria: Hero artwork approved in Figma with accessible contrast ratios (WCAG AA)
Animated hero preview (Lottie) integrated in staging Quickstart page and performance-tested (<200ms init on modern browsers)
Three responsive step frames exported at required breakpoints and validated against live screenshots
Screenshot pipeline script available in GitHub with docs, masks PII, and runs in CI to produce release assets
Design handoff complete with tokens, component specs, and annotated redlines
design_notes: Visual language will shift from illustrative gradients to a modular tile mosaic that highlights three product moments: API key creation, immediate sample request, and console observability. Illustrations use a constrained 4-color palette derived from brand tokens to keep file sizes low and simplify localization of microcopy overlays. Use SVG + small APNG fallback for older browsers. For animations prefer vector-based Lottie exported from After Effects with Bodymovin plugin.
decisions: Use 4-color palette to meet performance and printing constraints
Animate only the middle tile in hero to preserve CPU on low-end devices
Adopt content-safe screenshot mask (rounded blur + overlay) instead of redaction strips to preserve composition consistency
Prefer SVG for diagrams; provide PNGs at 2x for CMS fallback
tasks: Create hero static compositions (3 variants: full-bleed, content-width, compact)
Design animated Lottie hero (looping 6s, reduced particle count)
Produce step mosaic grid with labeled hotspots and alt text
Coordinate with Engineering to instrument screenshot export (masking, tokenization)
Export responsive assets and add to CDN manifest
comments: 2026-02-11 - Maya Chen: Kickoff with PM and Eng — agreed on scope reduction (no full animation for all tiles) to stay within sprint.
2026-02-18 - Liam O'Connor: Uploaded first-pass composites to Figma; requested tighter spacing on tiles and larger CTA.
2026-02-22 - Priya Singh (PM): Prefer showing 'Create API key' as first tile — higher conversion signal per analytics.
2026-03-01 - Engineering review (Noah Patel): Raised concern about Lottie size on Safari; recommended fallback to animated SVG for certain effects.
2026-03-05 - Design review: Agreed to reduce particle density and switch to vector strokes; updated files in Figma.
2026-03-10 - Accessibility review (Ruth Alvarez): Contrast adjusted on microcopy; added aria-hidden where decorative.
2026-03-12 - Liam O'Connor: Integrated screenshot pipeline PR linked; CI job produces masked PNGs on merge — awaiting final handoff to Docs for publishing.
notes_for_engineering: Key engineering ask: screenshot-pipeline must accept env var for CI run to use masking-level ('blur'|'pixelate'|'obfuscate'), output fixed filenames for each breakpoint, and expose basic audit log. Work with ENG-2891 for CDN purge rules.
release_notes: Updated Quickstart landing: new hero mosaic, animated preview on supported browsers, refreshed step frames with accurate screenshots and improved accessibility.
